verses.en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
verses.pt: Seis dias depois, tomou Jesus consigo a Pedro, a Tiago e a João, irmão deste, e os conduziu à parte a um alto monte;
verses.en_web: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
verses.en_bbe: And after six days Jesus takes with him Peter, and James, and John, his brother, and makes them go up with him into a high mountain by themselves.

verses.en: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
verses.pt: e foi transfigurado diante deles; o seu rosto resplandeceu como o sol, e as suas vestes tornaram-se brancas como a luz.
verses.en_web: He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
verses.en_bbe: And he was changed in form before them; and his face was shining like the sun, and his clothing became white as light.

verses.en: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
verses.pt: E eis que lhes apareceram Moisés e Elias, falando com ele.
verses.en_web: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses and Elijah came before their eyes, talking with him.

verses.en: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.pt: Pedro, tomando a palavra, disse a Jesus: Senhor, bom é estarmos aqui; se queres, farei aqui três cabanas, uma para ti, outra para Moisés, e outra para Elias.
verses.en_web: Peter answered, and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
verses.en_bbe: And Peter made answer and said to Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if you will let me, I will make here three tents, one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

verses.en: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
verses.pt: Estando ele ainda a falar, eis que uma nuvem luminosa os cobriu; e dela saiu uma voz que dizia: Este é o meu Filho amado, em quem me comprazo; a ele ouvi.
verses.en_web: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”
verses.en_bbe: While he was still talking, a bright cloud came over them: and a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased; give ear to him.

verses.en: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
verses.pt: Os discípulos, ouvindo isso, cairam com o rosto em terra, e ficaram grandemente atemorizados.
verses.en_web: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
verses.en_bbe: And at these words the disciples went down on their faces in great fear.

verses.en: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
verses.pt: Chegou-se, pois, Jesus e, tocando-os, disse: Levantai-vos e não temais.
verses.en_web: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus came and put his hand on them and said, Get up and have no fear.

verses.en: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
verses.pt: E, erguendo eles os olhos, não viram a ninguém senão a Jesus somente.
verses.en_web: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.
verses.en_bbe: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, but Jesus only.

verses.en: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
verses.pt: Enquanto desciam do monte, Jesus lhes ordenou: A ninguém conteis a visão, até que o Filho do homem seja levantado dentre os mortos.
verses.en_web: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”
verses.en_bbe: And when they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus gave them orders, saying, Let no man have word of what you have seen, till the Son of man has come again from the dead.

verses.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.pt: Perguntaram-lhe os discípulos: Por que dizem então os escribas que é necessário que Elias venha primeiro?
verses.en_web: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
verses.en_bbe: And his disciples, questioning him, said, Why then do the scribes say that Elijah has to come first?

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
verses.pt: Respondeu ele: Na verdade Elias havia de vir e restaurar todas as coisas;
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things,
verses.en_bbe: And in answer he said, Elijah truly has to come and put all things right:

verses.en: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
verses.pt: digo-vos, porém, que Elias já veio, e não o reconheceram; mas fizeram-lhe tudo o que quiseram. Assim também o Filho do homem há de padecer às mãos deles.
verses.en_web: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
verses.en_bbe: But I say to you that Elijah has come, and they had no knowledge of him, but did to him whatever they were pleased to do; the same will the Son of man undergo at their hands.

verses.en: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
verses.pt: Então entenderam os discípulos que lhes falava a respeito de João, o Batista.
verses.en_web: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
verses.en_bbe: Then the disciples saw that he was talking to them of John the Baptist.

verses.en: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
verses.pt: Quando chegaram à multidão, aproximou-se de Jesus um homem que, ajoelhando-se diante dele, disse:
verses.en_web: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him, and saying,
verses.en_bbe: And when they came to the people, a man went down on his knees to him, saying,

verses.en: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
verses.pt: Senhor, tem compaixão de meu filho, porque é epiléptico e sofre muito; pois muitas vezes cai no fogo, e muitas vezes na água.
verses.en_web: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic, and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
verses.en_bbe: Lord have mercy on my son: for he is off his head, and is in great pain; and frequently he goes falling into the fire, and frequently into the water.

verses.en: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
verses.pt: Eu o trouxe aos teus discípulos, e não o puderam curar.
verses.en_web: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”
verses.en_bbe: And I took him to your disciples, and they were not able to make him well.

verses.en: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
verses.pt: E Jesus, respondendo, disse: Ó geração incrédula e perversa! até quando estarei convosco? até quando vos sofrerei? Trazei-mo aqui.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, answering, said, O false and foolish generation, how long will I be with you? how long will I put up with you? let him come here to me.

verses.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
verses.pt: Então Jesus repreendeu ao demônio, o qual saiu de menino, que desde aquela hora ficou curado.
verses.en_web: Jesus rebuked him, the demon went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus gave orders to the unclean spirit, and it went out of him: and the boy was made well from that hour.

verses.en: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.pt: Depois os discípulos, aproximando-se de Jesus em particular, perguntaram-lhe: Por que não pudemos nós expulsá-lo?
verses.en_web: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
verses.en_bbe: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, Why were we not able to send it out?

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes ele: Por causa da vossa pouca fé; pois em verdade vos digo que, se tiverdes fé como um grão de mostarda direis a este monte: Passa daqui para acolá, e ele há de passar; e nada vos será impossível.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.
verses.en_bbe: And he says to them, Because of your little faith: for truly I say to you, If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, Be moved from this place to that; and it will be moved; and nothing will be impossible to you.

verses.en: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
verses.pt: [mas esta casta de demônios não se expulsa senão à força de oração e de jejum.]
verses.en_web: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

verses.en: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
verses.pt: Ora, achando-se eles na Galiléia, disse-lhes Jesus: O Filho do homem está para ser entregue nas mãos dos homens;
verses.en_web: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,
verses.en_bbe: And while they were going about in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of man will be given up into the hands of men;

verses.en: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
verses.pt: e matá-lo-ão, e ao terceiro dia ressurgirá. E eles se entristeceram grandemente.
verses.en_web: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
verses.en_bbe: And they will put him to death, and the third day he will come again from the dead. And they were very sad.

verses.en: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
verses.pt: Tendo eles chegado a Cafarnaum, aproximaram-se de Pedro os que cobravam as didracmas, e lhe perguntaram: O vosso mestre não paga as didracmas?
verses.en_web: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”
verses.en_bbe: And when they had come to Capernaum, those who took the Temple tax came to Peter and said, Does not your master make payment of the Temple tax?

verses.en: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
verses.pt: Disse ele: Sim. Ao entrar Pedro em casa, Jesus se lhe antecipou, perguntando: Que te parece, Simão? De quem cobram os reis da terra imposto ou tributo? dos seus filhos, ou dos alheios?
verses.en_web: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”
verses.en_bbe: He says, Yes. And when he came into the house, Jesus said to him, What is your opinion, Simon? from whom do the kings of the earth get payment or tax? from their sons or from other people?

verses.en: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
verses.pt: Quando ele respondeu: Dos alheios, disse-lhe Jesus: Logo, são isentos os filhos.
verses.en_web: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.
verses.en_bbe: And when he said, From other people, Jesus said to him, Then are the sons free.

verses.en: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
verses.pt: Mas, para que não os escandalizemos, vai ao mar, lança o anzol, tira o primeiro peixe que subir e, abrindo-lhe a boca, encontrarás um estáter; toma-o, e dá-lho por mim e por ti.
verses.en_web: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”
verses.en_bbe: But, so that we may not be a cause of trouble to them, go to the sea, and let down a hook, and take the first fish which comes up; and in his mouth you will see a bit of money: take that, and give it to them for me and you.
